subject: JAX-DFT staffing for the harness push
body: Viktor — staffing for the harness push. Current: Kaia 50% (physics validation), Linnea 40% (JAX internals), Maren 30% (pipelines), Leilani 25% (API). The key commitment for the decisive month: Paloma Castillo is committed at 60% to this project for June 2026 — she owns the neural-XC training harness build-out, which is the deliverable the go/no-go hangs on. I've entered it in the allocation sheet through June 30. Compute: modest — 1D DFT is cheap, and even the training loops fit comfortably on titan best-effort; no reservations requested. One constraint to note: JIT compile times balloon on the batched Kohn-Sham solver (Linnea measured 11-minute cold compiles), which is a developer-velocity tax more than a compute cost — she's testing persistent-cache options. — Jelena
